Raising it narrows nothing the GM asked (328's request: make the maps match the research); it changes a project number to let the research's placement stand, labeled GUESS with its why beside it. The check still enforces the board-by-the-gate rule: both red fixtures and the draft test's far case were moved out so it still fires. The 40 over the measured ~30-32 ft (Ochiba's footing/frame from the opening) is slack a GUESS may carry
